unit_translation.target_unit: BR runs per 100 times on base

selection_note: Per contrast: the 20 largest forecast increases, the 20 largest decreases, and 20 randomly drawn player-seasons (seed 42) from the outer years 2021-2025. Single-feature contrasts: history baseline vs baseline + the metric (ridge). Population: players meeting the study's eligibility in both seasons (outcome observed). Extreme cases are not typical.
